name: Cirrus
description: A minimalist, light-as-air SaaS design system built around a calm cloudy sky background, pill-shaped controls, and a single italic serif accent that punctuates an otherwise restrained sans-serif voice.
concept: Cirrus treats the page as open sky. A soft, gradient-and-cloud backdrop holds the entire system, and content floats as crisp, white, pill-radius surfaces with hairline borders and ultra-soft shadows. Typography is the workhorse: a tightly tracked geometric sans carries every label and headline, broken once per hero by an oversized italic serif phrase that mimics a pause for breath. CTAs are obsidian-black pills. Data uses a calm tri-color accent of sky blue, citrus orange, and meadow green. Nothing decorative survives; whitespace is the texture.

palette.name: Sky
palette.role: Primary page background, blended with the cloud gradient

palette.name: Horizon
palette.role: Upper sky gradient anchor and ambient halo

palette.name: Cloud
palette.role: Floating surface for cards, inputs, and panels

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Primary text, dark CTA fill, and high-contrast headlines

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: Secondary text, supporting labels, muted iconography

palette.name: Signal Blue
palette.role: Primary data accent, focus ring, link color

palette.name: Citrus
palette.role: Secondary data accent and warm callouts

palette.name: Meadow
palette.role: Tertiary data accent and positive indicators

fonts.name: Instrument Serif
fonts.usage: Italic accent phrase inside hero headlines, used once per page

iconPack.name: Lucide
iconPack.usage: Used for navigation, controls, and metric labels at 16-20px in Mist or Ink; never scaled into a hero graphic.
